page_title: ESP 0-2 RMA | Espanyol v Real Madrid 03/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Jesus Manzano is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+3' Excellent touch by Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
90+2' Marko Dmitrovic leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid).
90+1' Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Real Madrid.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
87' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
87' A quickly taken corner by Espanyol.

87' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Espanyol are going to take it.
85' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jesus Manzano had an easy-decision to make.
84' Alvaro Arbeloa has decided to substitute Vinicius Junior and he is replaced by Cesar Palacios (Real Madrid).
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aurelien Tchouameni departs the field of play to be replaced by Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid).

81' Vinicius Junior sprays a wonderful pass out to Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Marko Dmitrovic problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just over the crossbar.
80' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jesus Manzano no option but to blow his whistle.

79' A neat pass is well received by Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
76' Real Madrid fail to score from a corner as Marko Dmitrovic (Espanyol) leaps to collect the ball.
75' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) receives a yellow card!

75' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Andriy Lunin was alert and the score remained the same.
74' None of the Espanyol players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
73' We are about to witness a substitution. Pere Milla (Espanyol) is replacing Tyrhys Dolan.
73' Manolo Gonzalez decides to make a substitution. Roberto Fernandez Jaen will be replaced by Kike Garcia (Espanyol).
73' Substitution. Ramon Terrats makes way for Jofre (Espanyol).
73' A pass lands at the feet of Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Espanyol will take a corner kick.
71' Dangerous play by Ramon Terrats (Espanyol). Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
70' Real Madrid work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
70' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Real Madrid get a corner.

66' 0 - 2 Goal! Jude Bellingham puts Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) in the clear with just the keeper to beat. He takes his shot early from the edge of the box and scores beautifully into the top right corner. 0:2.
65' Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the left post.
64' The resulting free kick from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
64' Fernando Calero (Espanyol) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jesus Manzano signals.
63' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
61' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Charles Pickel (Espanyol) replacing Exposito.
61' Substitution. Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) replaces Ruben Sanchez.
60' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) is adjudged offside.

58' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Jesus Manzano blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
57' Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders.

55' 0 - 1 Gonzalo Garcia passes the ball into the penalty area. Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) collects it and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner via the post! The goalkeeper was helpless. 0:1!
53' Here is a change. Brahim Diaz is going off and Alvaro Arbeloa gives the last tactical orders to Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid).
53' It's time for a substitution. Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) comes on in place of Thiago Pitarch.
51' Exposito (Espanyol) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
50' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) commits a nasty foul by bringing down his opponent.
47' What a miskick by Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
46' The attendance is 31733.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Exposito (Espanyol) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
45+3' Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. It will be a corner kick for Espanyol.
45+2' Exposito (Espanyol) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
45+1' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is penalised for holding. Jesus Manzano signals a set piece.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' The free kick from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out.

42' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jesus Manzano with no other option than to blow for a foul. Real Madrid are awarded a free kick.
41' Exposito (Espanyol) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
41' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Espanyol will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
40' Marko Dmitrovic makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) after a cross from the side.
38' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for an infringement.
36' Exposito (Espanyol) steps up to send the ball in.
36' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball is out of play. Espanyol win a corner kick.
34' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jesus Manzano blows for a foul.
33' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
30' Marko Dmitrovic leaps to intercept the corner kick from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid).

30' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play and Real Madrid manage to earn a corner.
29' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar.
29' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Big moment in the game as the red card awarded to Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) is reduced to a yellow following the VAR review!

26' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Omar El Hilali (Espanyol), but referee Jesus Manzano must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
26' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) looks sheepishly at the ref as he knows what's going to happen after his poor tackle. And he's right! Jesus Manzano sends him off the pitch with a straight red!
23' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
22' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) has tested the patience of referee Jesus Manzano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
18' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.

15' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. Real Madrid can continue in their attacking effort.
14' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
14' Problems for Alvaro Arbeloa as Ferland Mendy is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) replaces him.

13' Fernando Calero (Espanyol) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Real Madrid, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
12' It doesn’t look good for Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
11' Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
10' Jesus Manzano couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) and blew his whistle.
8' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) takes the corner but it's cleared.

8' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Real Madrid.
8' What an opportunity! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) smashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but the ball only crashed against the right post!
8' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.

4' Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the left post! The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
3' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
1' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
1' Jesus Manzano blows for a foul after Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
The players are out at last! Real Madrid will take the kick-off.
Jesus Manzano was nominated as the referee for this game.
